about: The small sites of a generated country, by kind (src/world/region-sites.ts, region-geography.ts): how one is seen from afar until its name is known (seen), how it looks come to (look), what the folk nearby say of it (said: a work's makers' own sayings are said of a work instead), and, for one that carries its old name, where it is cut (cut). gloss: how a name's meaning is said: of a work's name (work), a name in the old tongue (old: {gloss}), any other (plain: {gloss}). Add a kind here and the sites table (data/generation/tables) can place it.

cave.look: A dark mouth opens in the hillside.
cave.said: There is always something living in it.

barrow.look: A long grassed mound with a stone-lined entrance.
barrow.cut: On the stone across the entrance, in the old script

ruin.look: Fallen walls in rough grass; someone built here once.
ruin.said: Older than the town. Folk take stone from it, when they dare.
ruin.cut: On a fallen lintel, in the old script

tower.look: A lone tower stands above the land.
tower.said: Nobody has lived there since my grandmother's day.
tower.cut: Over the door, cut in the old script

grove.look: Old trees crowd close, and the light under them is green.

bog.look: Black water between tussocks; the path is a line of stakes.
bog.said: Keep to the stakes, if you go.

mine.look: Spoil heaps and a timbered adit.
mine.said: Worked out, my father said, and he would know.

sinkhole.look: Grass runs to the edge of a round pit in the ground.
sinkhole.said: Sheep go in. They do not come out.

gloss.work: An old name; nobody knows what it means.
